curriculum.heading: The full 10-month course
curriculum.description: Each month builds on the last — from the alphabet to independent, everyday Finnish.

m1.title: Finnish Foundations
m1.desc: The alphabet, pronunciation, and your first sentences.
m1.topics: Alphabet,Vowels & consonants,Long & short sounds,Syllables & stress,Personal pronouns,The verb olla,Basic sentences

m2.title: Verbs & Everyday Sentences
m2.desc: Present-tense verbs, verb types, and everyday vocabulary.
m2.topics: Verb stem,Personal endings,Present tense,Positive & negative forms,Verb types 1–6,Infinitive,Greetings,Family & work

m3.title: K-P-T & Nouns
m3.topics: K-P-T gradation,Strong & weak grade,Nouns,Singular & plural,Word stems,Exceptions

m4.title: Cases I
m4.desc: The first seven Finnish cases and how to use them.

m5.title: Cases II
m5.desc: The remaining cases, compared and applied.

m6.title: Objects, Pronouns & Adjectives
m6.desc: Objects, pronouns, and how adjectives change.
m6.topics: Total object,Partitive object,Objects in negatives,Pronoun case forms,Demonstrative pronouns,Kuka / mikä,Adjective + noun,Comparative & superlative

m7.title: Past & Other Verb Forms
m7.desc: Past tenses, the conditional, and the imperative.

m8.title: Sentence Construction
m8.desc: Sentence structure, word order, and clauses.
m8.topics: Word order,Questions,Negative sentences,että / koska / jos,kun / vaikka,Relative clauses,Longer sentences

m9.title: Real-Life Finnish
m9.desc: Practical Finnish for everyday life — and spoken forms.
m9.topics: Shopping,Restaurant,Transportation,Doctor,Workplace,Housing,Government services,Spoken forms: mä / sä / se / ne

m10.title: Finnish Independence
m10.desc: A full review, building toward independent Finnish.
m10.topics: Grammar review,Speaking practice,Everyday conversations,Writing messages & forms,Emails,Reading,Listening,Final practice

q2.q: How many live classes are there each week?
q2.a: There are two live classes per week.

q3.a: Each class is 2 hours long, for 4 hours per week in total.

q4.q: What platform is used for live classes?
q4.a: Live classes are held on Zoom.

q5.q: What languages are used for teaching?
q5.a: Finnish stays Finnish. Explanations are given primarily in Bangla, with English used when it's helpful for comparison.

q6.a: The course moves from Finnish foundations to independent Finnish over ten months: foundations, verbs, K-P-T, cases, objects, pronouns and adjectives, past verb forms, sentence construction, real-life Finnish, and independent Finnish.

q7.q: Is the course suitable for beginners?
q7.a: Yes. The course starts from Finnish foundations, including the alphabet and pronunciation.

q8.q: What are the available pricing options?
q8.a: Live Monthly at €35 / month, Lifetime Video at €100 one-time, and 10-Month Live at €350 total.

q9.q: What is included in the Lifetime Video option?
q9.a: Recorded lessons, lifetime access to materials, and self-paced learning — without live classes.

q10.q: How can I contact Suomen Polku?
q10.a: You can reach out using the contact form on this page.
